python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=/opt/rh2/build-wheels --no-deps pygit2==1.14.1 &&
rh2_recipe_install() {
  python -m pip install --no-deps pygit2==1.14.1 || return $?
  python -m pip install -e '.[all,tests]'
  local install_rc=$?
  python -I -c 'import importlib.metadata as m,json; print("RH2_DVC_DEPS="+json.dumps({x:m.version(x) for x in ['"'"'dvc'"'"', '"'"'pygit2'"'"']}))'
  return "$install_rc"
